title: quercus petraea subsp. mas
intro: Quercus petraea subsp. mas, commonly known as sessile oak or Irish oak, is a subspecies of oak tree native to Europe, particularly in Ireland and the UK. This tree is valued for its timber and medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Quercus petraea subsp. mas include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
